title: Multi-Stage Toxicity Prediction for Drug Discovery Using Fingerprints, GNNs & Knowledge Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Five-stage cooperative learning pipeline addressing extreme label sparsity (<0.5% labeled). Integrates Morgan fingerprint initialization, GIN, data-driven Knowledge Graph construction, and ensemble fusion. Validated on 79,002 molecules from ZINC, ChEMBL, and Tox21.

title: Predicting Dominant Gamete Contribution in Fertilization Using Genomic & Phenotypic Characteristics
abstract: Novel hybrid AI-bioinformatics pipeline predicting gamete dominance in fertilization. Integrates WHO semen data, SHBG synthetic SNPs, and oocyte transcriptomic profiles (GSE107746). Random Forest achieves 92% accuracy (ROC-AUC 0.94). SHAP reveals BMP15, GDF9, ZP3 as primary drivers.

title: Continual Learning on CIFAR-100 via Hard Attention to Task (HAT) with Memory-Aware Replay & EWC
domain: Continual Learning · Catastrophic Forgetting · Computer Vision
abstract: Research evolution: RoutedMLP (26%) → CNN routing (41%) → ResNet18 (49%) → HAT achieving 58.86% on Split-CIFAR-100. Task-specific sigmoid attention gates with EWC regularization and episodic memory replay to combat catastrophic forgetting.
